ex.en: Don't click on that link.
ex.zh: 不要點選那個連結。

ex.en: Here are some interesting links.
ex.zh: 這裡有些有趣的連結。

ex.en: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.
ex.zh: 請不要回覆這封詐騙郵件，更不要點擊信中的連結。

link.en: a part of a web page that you click to go to another page

ex.en: There is a link between smoking and cancer.
ex.zh: 抽菸和癌症之間有關聯。

ex.en: Police are looking for links between the two crimes.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找兩起犯罪之間的關聯。

link.en: a connection between two things or ideas

ex.en: Our hearts are linked.
ex.zh: 我們心意相通。

ex.en: The tunnel links the two cities.
ex.zh: 這條隧道連接兩座城市。

link.en: to connect two or more things together

ex.en: The librarian helped me find the book.
ex.zh: 圖書館員幫我找到了那本書。

ex.en: Amy works as a librarian at the city library.
ex.zh: Amy 在市立圖書館當館員。

librarian.en: a person who works in a place where books are kept for borrowing

ex.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
ex.zh: 這樣的機會一輩子只會遇到一次。

ex.en: Some things I will never be able to learn in my lifetime.
ex.zh: 有些東西我這輩子永遠學不會。

lifetime.en: the whole time that a person is alive

ex.en: The product comes with a lifetime warranty.
ex.zh: 這項產品享有終身保固。

ex.en: He received a lifetime achievement award.
ex.zh: 他獲頒終身成就獎。

lifetime.en: lasting for the whole of a person's life

ex.en: He has problems with adapting to lifestyle changes.
ex.zh: 他很難適應生活方式的改變。

ex.en: A healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise.
ex.zh: 健康的生活方式包括規律運動。

ex.en: Moving to the countryside changed our lifestyle.
ex.zh: 搬到鄉下改變了我們的生活方式。

lifestyle.en: the way a person lives, including their habits and activities

ex.en: Tom is tall and likewise strong.
ex.zh: 湯姆個子高，也一樣強壯。

ex.en: Amy left early, and Tom did likewise.
ex.zh: 艾美提早走了，湯姆也一樣。

ex.en: "I hate you!" "Likewise."
ex.zh: 「我討厭你！」「彼此彼此。」

ex.en: "Nice to meet you." "Likewise."
ex.zh: 「很高興認識你。」「我也是。」

likewise.en: used to say that you feel the same way as someone else

ex.en: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.
ex.zh: 先生，您把打火機忘在桌上了。

ex.en: Have you got a lighter?
ex.zh: 你有打火機嗎？

lighter.en: a small device that makes a flame, used to start a cigarette or a fire

lighter.zh: （light 的比較級）較輕的；較淺的；較亮的

ex.en: Is it a bit lighter or a bit heavier?
ex.zh: 是輕一點，還是重一點？

ex.en: He likes green in a lighter shade.
ex.zh: 他喜歡淺一點的綠色。

ex.en: It is getting lighter outside.
ex.zh: 外面天色越來越亮了。

lighter.en: weighing less, or paler or brighter in color than something else

ex.en: This laptop is lightweight and easy to carry.
ex.zh: 這台筆電很輕，方便攜帶。

ex.en: Bring a lightweight jacket for the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行時帶一件輕便的外套。

lightweight.en: not heavy and easy to carry

ex.en: I applied for a job as a lifeguard at the community pool.
ex.zh: 我去社區游泳池應徵救生員的工作。

ex.en: The lifeguard told the kids to stop running.
ex.zh: 救生員叫孩子們不要奔跑。

lifeguard.en: a person whose job is to watch swimmers and save them from danger

ex.en: I drink 1.7 liters of water each day.
ex.zh: 我每天喝 1.7 公升的水。

ex.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
ex.zh: 這輛車每公升汽油可以跑十三公里。

ex.en: This bottle is able to contain two liters of hot water.
ex.zh: 這個瓶子可以裝兩公升的熱水。

liter.en: a unit for measuring liquid, equal to 1,000 milliliters

ex.en: You are liable for the debt.
ex.zh: 你有責任償還這筆債務。

ex.en: You're liable for the debt.
ex.zh: 這筆債務由你負責償還。

ex.en: The company is liable for any damage to the goods.
ex.zh: 公司須對貨物的任何損壞負責。

liable.en: responsible by law for something, especially for paying

ex.en: A newborn baby is liable to fall ill.
ex.zh: 新生兒很容易生病。

ex.en: We are all liable to make mistakes.
ex.zh: 我們每個人都難免會犯錯。

liable.en: likely to do or suffer something bad

ex.en: Is the system linear?
ex.zh: 這個系統是線性的嗎？

ex.en: Growth is not always linear.
ex.zh: 成長不一定是線性的。

ex.en: The story is told in a linear way.
ex.zh: 這個故事是按時間順序講述的。

linear.en: in a straight line, or going from one step to the next in order

likelihood.zh: 可能性；in all likelihood 很可能

ex.en: In all likelihood, this means war.
ex.zh: 這很可能意味著戰爭。

ex.en: What is the likelihood of rain tomorrow?
ex.zh: 明天下雨的機率有多高？

ex.en: Exercise reduces the likelihood of heart disease.
ex.zh: 運動能降低罹患心臟病的可能性。

likelihood.en: the chance that something will happen

ex.en: The company is facing litigation over the defect.
ex.zh: 公司因這項瑕疵面臨訴訟。

ex.en: Litigation can be very expensive.
ex.zh: 打官司可能非常花錢。

litigation.en: the process of taking a dispute to a court of law

liquidation.zh: 清算、清盤（公司結束營業）

ex.en: The company went into liquidation last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年進入清算程序。

ex.en: The store is having a liquidation sale before it closes.
ex.zh: 這家店在歇業前舉辦清倉大拍賣。

liquidation.en: the process of closing a company and selling what it owns to pay its debts

ex.en: They fought for their liberty.
ex.zh: 他們為自由而戰。

ex.en: The prisoner was set at liberty.
ex.zh: 囚犯重獲自由。

liberty.en: the freedom to live and act as you choose

liberty.zh: take the liberty of：冒昧（擅自）做某事

ex.en: I took the liberty of booking a table for us.
ex.zh: 我冒昧先幫我們訂了位。

ex.en: I've taken the liberty of sending you our catalog.
ex.zh: 我冒昧寄了我們的型錄給您。

liberty.en: to do something without asking first, hoping it is acceptable

liberty.zh: at liberty to：獲准、可以（做某事）

ex.en: I'm not at liberty to discuss the details.
ex.zh: 我不便透露細節。

ex.en: We are not at liberty to share client information.
ex.zh: 我們無權透露客戶資料。

ex.en: The company was forced to liquidate after years of losses.
ex.zh: 這家公司連年虧損後被迫清算。

ex.en: The firm will be liquidated next month.
ex.zh: 這家公司下個月將進行清算。

liquidate.en: to close a company and sell what it owns to pay its debts

ex.en: They liquidated their stocks to pay off debts.
ex.zh: 他們賣掉股票來還債。

ex.en: We may need to liquidate some assets.
ex.zh: 我們可能需要變賣部分資產。

liquidate.en: to sell things you own in order to get money

ex.en: Trade liberalization has opened up new markets.
ex.zh: 貿易自由化開拓了新市場。

ex.en: The liberalization of the telecom industry lowered prices.
ex.zh: 電信業自由化讓價格下降了。

liberalization.en: the act of making rules or laws less strict

ex.en: The government plans to liberalize trade with its neighbors.
ex.zh: 政府計畫放寬與鄰國的貿易限制。

ex.en: The country liberalized its banking laws last year.
ex.zh: 這個國家去年放寬了銀行法規。

liberalize.en: to make rules or laws less strict

ex.en: He likes not only baseball but football as well.
ex.zh: 他不但喜歡棒球，也喜歡足球。

ex.en: I liked Tom's first book more than the second.
ex.zh: 比起第二本，我更喜歡湯姆的第一本書。

like.en: to enjoy something or think that someone or something is nice

ex.en: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
ex.zh: 我想和你一起去海邊。

ex.en: Would you like something to drink?
ex.zh: 你想喝點什麼嗎？

like.en: a polite way of saying that you want something

ex.en: She sings like a professional.
ex.zh: 她唱歌像專業歌手一樣。

ex.en: What's your new boss like?
ex.zh: 你的新老闆是個怎樣的人？

like.en: similar to, or in the same way as

ex.en: I enjoy outdoor sports like hiking and cycling.
ex.zh: 我喜歡戶外運動，像是健行和騎自行車。

ex.en: Fruits like apples and bananas are cheap here.
ex.zh: 這裡像蘋果、香蕉這類水果很便宜。

like.en: used to give an example of something

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多改變。

ex.en: City life is very busy.
ex.zh: 都市生活很忙碌。

life.en: the way that people live and spend their time

ex.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
ex.zh: 一百萬人在戰爭中喪生。

ex.en: The doctor saved her life.
ex.zh: 醫生救了她一命。

ex.en: One more effort, you will get on in life.
ex.zh: 再努力一點，你在人生中就會成功。

ex.en: She spent her whole life in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她一輩子都住在台北。

life.en: the time from birth to death of a person

ex.en: The little girl has a doll in her hands.
ex.zh: 小女孩手裡拿著一個洋娃娃。

ex.en: The heroine of this story is a little girl.
ex.zh: 這個故事的女主角是個小女孩。

little.en: small in size or young in age

ex.en: The information you gave me is of little use.
ex.zh: 你給我的資訊沒什麼用。

ex.en: There is little time left.
ex.zh: 剩下的時間不多了。

ex.en: With a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
ex.zh: 如果他當時再努力一點，就會成功了。

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 有沒有便宜一點的房間？

ex.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
ex.zh: 能不能請你說慢一點？

ex.en: Tatsuya has some friends who live in New York.
ex.zh: 達也有幾個朋友住在紐約。

ex.en: Once there lived an old man in a village.
ex.zh: 從前，村子裡住著一位老人。

live.en: to have your home in a particular place

ex.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
ex.zh: 他很有錢，卻過得像個乞丐。

ex.en: We live a simple life.
ex.zh: 我們過著簡單的生活。

live.en: to spend your life in a certain way

ex.en: We watched the live broadcast.
ex.zh: 我們看了現場直播。

ex.en: The band played live music all night.
ex.zh: 樂團整晚現場演奏。

live.en: happening at the moment, not recorded earlier

ex.en: This room gets a lot of natural light.
ex.zh: 這個房間採光很好。

ex.en: The light from the screen hurts my eyes.
ex.zh: 螢幕的光讓我眼睛很不舒服。

light.en: brightness that lets you see things

ex.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
ex.zh: 你介意我把燈關掉嗎？

ex.en: After you get to the traffic lights, turn right.
ex.zh: 到了紅綠燈後右轉。

light.en: a device that gives out brightness, such as an electric lamp

ex.en: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
ex.zh: 氫是最輕的元素。

ex.en: This laptop is very light.
ex.zh: 這台筆電非常輕。

ex.en: It was cold, so we lit a fire.
ex.zh: 天氣很冷，所以我們生了火。

ex.en: He lit a candle on the table.
ex.zh: 他點了桌上的一根蠟燭。

light.en: to make something start to burn

ex.en: Delete his name from the list of the applicants.
ex.zh: 把他的名字從申請人名單中刪除。

ex.en: Could you put my name on the waiting list?
ex.zh: 可以把我的名字列在候補名單上嗎？

ex.en: I made a list of things to buy.
ex.zh: 我列了一張購物清單。

list.en: a series of names or items written one after another

ex.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
ex.zh: 箱子裡的物品都列在標籤上。

ex.en: Please list your skills on the form.
ex.zh: 請在表格上列出你的技能。

list.en: to write or say things one after another

ex.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
ex.zh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市。

ex.en: The company plans to be listed next year.
ex.zh: 這家公司計畫明年上市。

list.en: to put a company's shares on an official stock market

ex.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。

ex.en: He is likely to be late for school.
ex.zh: 他上學很可能會遲到。

ex.en: Mary isn't likely to be hungry when she gets here.
ex.zh: 瑪莉到這裡時應該不會餓。

ex.en: You ought to tell Tom that you'll likely be late.
ex.zh: 你應該告訴湯姆你可能會遲到。

ex.en: The meeting will most likely be canceled.
ex.zh: 會議很可能會取消。

ex.en: In towns, speed is limited to 50 km/h.
ex.zh: 市區內速限為每小時五十公里。

ex.en: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
ex.zh: 怎麼用路由器限制網速？

ex.en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
ex.zh: 限制白糖和鹽的攝取量。

limit.en: to keep something from going above a certain amount

ex.en: Human stupidity knows no limits.
ex.zh: 人類的愚蠢沒有極限。

ex.en: Each speaker has a time limit of ten minutes.
ex.zh: 每位講者有十分鐘的時間限制。

ex.en: Don't go over the speed limit.
ex.zh: 不要超過速限。

limit.en: the greatest amount or point that is allowed or possible

ex.en: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你可以聽我說幾分鐘嗎？

ex.en: He often sits by me and listens to music.
ex.zh: 他常坐在我旁邊聽音樂。

ex.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.
ex.zh: 聽講座時應該保持安靜。

listen.en: to pay attention to a sound or to what someone says

ex.en: He never listens to my advice.
ex.zh: 他從來不聽我的建議。

ex.en: You should listen to your doctor.
ex.zh: 你應該聽醫生的話。

listen.en: to accept and follow what someone tells you

ex.en: He made an admission that he had lied.
ex.zh: 他承認自己說了謊。

ex.en: Don't lie to me.
ex.zh: 不要對我說謊。

lie.en: to say something that you know is not true

ex.en: Tom said he was ill, which was a lie.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他生病了，那是騙人的。

ex.en: I will never tell a lie from now on.
ex.zh: 從今以後我再也不說謊了。

lie.en: something you say that you know is not true

ex.en: He was found lying unconscious on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 有人發現他昏倒在廚房地板上。

ex.en: She is lying in bed with a cold.
ex.zh: 她感冒躺在床上。

lie.en: to rest in a flat position on a surface

ex.en: The town lies on the east coast.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮位於東岸。

ex.en: The problem lies in the design.
ex.zh: 問題出在設計上。

lie.en: to be in a certain place, or to have its cause in something

ex.en: How far is it to the library from here?
ex.zh: 從這裡到圖書館有多遠？

ex.en: I see him in the library now and then.
ex.zh: 我有時會在圖書館看到他。

ex.en: The library is in the middle of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

library.en: a place where books are kept for people to read or borrow

ex.en: This app uses an open-source library.
ex.zh: 這個 App 使用了開源函式庫。

ex.en: The company has a large library of training videos.
ex.zh: 公司有大量的訓練影片庫。

library.en: a collection of ready-made computer code, or a collection of things kept for use

ex.en: She lifted up her head and looked at him.
ex.zh: 她抬起頭看著他。

ex.en: I can't lift a suitcase heavier than 30 kilos.
ex.zh: 我沒辦法提起超過三十公斤的行李箱。

ex.en: Please help me lift this box.
ex.zh: 請幫我抬這個箱子。

lift.en: to move something up to a higher position

ex.en: Trade barriers were lifted after the war ended.
ex.zh: 戰爭結束後，貿易壁壘就解除了。

ex.en: The government lifted the ban on imports.
ex.zh: 政府解除了進口禁令。

lift.en: to end a rule or restriction

ex.en: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
ex.zh: 發生火災時，請勿搭乘電梯。

ex.en: I took the lift to the third floor.
ex.zh: 我搭電梯到三樓。

ex.en: Can you give me a lift to the station?
ex.zh: 你可以載我到車站嗎？

lift.en: a machine that carries people up and down in a building, or a free ride in a car

license.zh: 執照、許可證（driver's license 駕照）

ex.en: You're still too young to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 你還太小，不能考駕照。

ex.en: She's not old enough to get a driver's license.
ex.zh: 她還沒到可以考駕照的年紀。

ex.en: You need a license to sell alcohol.
ex.zh: 販售酒類需要執照。

license.en: an official paper that gives you permission to do something

ex.en: The software license expires next month.
ex.zh: 這套軟體的授權下個月到期。

ex.en: We bought licenses for 50 users.
ex.zh: 我們買了五十個使用者的授權。

license.en: official permission to use a piece of software

ex.en: The restaurant is licensed to serve alcohol.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有販售酒類的執照。

ex.en: The company licensed its technology to other firms.
ex.zh: 這家公司把技術授權給其他企業。

license.en: to give official permission for something

liberal.zh: 開明的、思想開放的；自由派的

ex.en: My parents are quite liberal about what I wear.
ex.zh: 我爸媽對我的穿著很開明。

ex.en: She has very liberal views on education.
ex.zh: 她對教育的看法非常開放。

liberal.en: accepting different ideas and ways of behaving, or supporting political change

ex.en: Don't be too liberal with the salt.
ex.zh: 鹽不要放太多。

ex.en: The company is liberal with its holiday bonuses.
ex.zh: 這家公司發節慶獎金很大方。

ex.en: He has always been a liberal.
ex.zh: 他一直都是自由派。

ex.en: Liberals and conservatives disagree on many issues.
ex.zh: 自由派和保守派在許多議題上意見分歧。

liberal.en: a person who supports political change and personal freedom

ex.en: You've got something on your lip.
ex.zh: 你的嘴唇上有東西。

ex.en: She pressed her lips together and willed herself not to cry.
ex.zh: 她抿緊嘴唇，強忍著不哭。

ex.en: My lips get dry in winter.
ex.zh: 我的嘴唇一到冬天就很乾。

lip.en: one of the two soft edges around the mouth

ex.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
ex.zh: 知名文學界人士昨晚齊聚一堂。

ex.en: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
ex.zh: 文學作品中常用夜來香來象徵思念與柔情。

ex.en: She won a major literary prize.
ex.zh: 她贏得了一項重要的文學獎。

literary.en: relating to books, poems and other writing of high quality

ex.en: We know it's difficult, but please don't translate literally.
ex.zh: 我們知道這很難，但請不要直譯。

ex.en: He took it literally.
ex.zh: 他把那句話照字面理解了。

literally.en: using the exact meaning of each word

ex.en: I was literally shaking with fear.
ex.zh: 我真的害怕得發抖。

ex.en: There were literally thousands of people there.
ex.zh: 那裡真的有好幾千人。

literally.en: used to stress that something is really true

ex.en: Tom is aware of his own limitations.
ex.zh: 湯姆很清楚自己的侷限。

ex.en: I know my limitations.
ex.zh: 我知道自己的極限在哪裡。

ex.en: Every software has its limitations.
ex.zh: 每套軟體都有它的限制。

limitation.en: a weakness or lack of ability in something

ex.en: There is a limitation on the number of guests.
ex.zh: 賓客人數有限制。

ex.en: The new rules place limitations on overtime work.
ex.zh: 新規定對加班設下限制。

limitation.en: a rule or condition that keeps something within a certain amount

ex.en: The company denied liability for the accident.
ex.zh: 公司否認對這起事故負有責任。

ex.en: You should buy liability insurance.
ex.zh: 你應該買責任保險。

liability.en: the state of being responsible for something by law

ex.en: The company's liabilities exceed its assets.
ex.zh: 這家公司的負債超過資產。

ex.en: Please list your assets and liabilities.
ex.zh: 請列出你的資產和負債。

liability.en: money that a person or company owes

ex.en: His bad temper is a liability to the team.
ex.zh: 他的壞脾氣成了團隊的累贅。

ex.en: The old equipment has become a liability.
ex.zh: 老舊設備已經成了負擔。

liability.en: someone or something that causes problems or disadvantages

ex.en: Water and oil are both liquids.
ex.zh: 水和油都是液體。

ex.en: You should drink a lot of liquid.
ex.zh: 你應該多補充水分。

ex.en: Liquids over 100 ml are not allowed in carry-on bags.
ex.zh: 超過 100 毫升的液體不能放在隨身行李裡。

liquid.en: a substance like water that flows and is not solid

ex.zh: 我不喜歡用洗衣精。

ex.zh: 水是液態的，結冰後就變成固態。

liquid.en: in a form that flows, not solid or gas

ex.en: The radio show has thousands of listeners.
ex.zh: 這個廣播節目有好幾千名聽眾。

ex.en: She's a good listener.
ex.zh: 她是個很好的傾聽者。

listener.en: a person who pays attention to a sound or to what others say

ex.en: Stretch your limbs after sitting for a long time.
ex.zh: 久坐之後要伸展四肢。

ex.en: The cold made my limbs feel stiff.
ex.zh: 寒冷讓我的四肢變得僵硬。

limb.en: an arm or leg of a person or animal

ex.en: A large limb fell from the tree during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨時一根大樹枝從樹上掉下來。

ex.en: The children climbed onto a low limb of the oak.
ex.zh: 孩子們爬上橡樹低處的一根枝幹。

limb.en: a large branch of a tree

limb.zh: go out on a limb：冒險表態、大膽支持

ex.en: I'll go out on a limb and say we'll win.
ex.zh: 我大膽預測我們會贏。

ex.en: She went out on a limb to support my idea.
ex.zh: 她冒著風險支持我的想法。

limb.en: to take a risk by saying or doing something that others may not agree with

ex.en: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
ex.zh: 生肖文化深植於人們的日常生活與語言文化中。

ex.en: Children have amazing linguistic abilities.
ex.zh: 孩子擁有驚人的語言能力。

ex.en: The country is famous for its linguistic diversity.
ex.zh: 這個國家以語言多樣性聞名。

ex.en: Linguistics is a very interesting field.
ex.zh: 語言學是很有意思的學科。

ex.en: My major is linguistics.
ex.zh: 我主修語言學。

ex.en: He is absorbed in the study of linguistics.
ex.zh: 他專心投入語言學研究。

ex.zh: 喝太多酒會傷肝。

ex.en: The liver helps remove toxins from the body.
ex.zh: 肝臟幫助身體排除毒素。

liver.en: a large body part that cleans the blood and helps with digestion

ex.en: In towns, speed is limited to 50 km/h.
ex.zh: 在市區內，車速限制在每小時五十公里以內。

ex.en: Seating is limited, so please register early.
ex.zh: 座位有限，請及早報名。

ex.en: We have limited time to finish the project.
ex.zh: 我們完成這個專案的時間有限。

ex.en: This limited edition watch sold out in one day.
ex.zh: 這款限量版手錶一天就賣完了。

ex.en: The offer is available for a limited period only.
ex.zh: 這項優惠只在限定期間內提供。

limited.en: made or sold in small numbers only

ex.en: Our company is a limited company.
ex.zh: 我們公司是有限公司。

ex.en: Our company is a limited-liability company.
ex.zh: 我們公司是有限責任公司。

limited.en: describing a company whose owners are not fully responsible for its debts

ex.en: The lieutenant gave orders to his soldiers.
ex.zh: 中尉向士兵下達命令。

ex.en: Her father retired as a police lieutenant.
ex.zh: 她父親以警察副隊長的職位退休。

lieutenant.en: an officer of low rank in the army, navy or police

ex.en: The CEO relies on a few trusted lieutenants.
ex.zh: 執行長倚重幾位信任的得力助手。

ex.en: He became the director's chief lieutenant.
ex.zh: 他成為主任最主要的副手。

lieutenant.en: a person who helps and acts for a leader

ex.en: The old church is built of limestone.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂是用石灰岩建造的。

ex.en: The cave was formed in limestone over millions of years.
ex.zh: 這個洞穴是石灰岩歷經數百萬年形成的。

limestone.en: a hard pale rock used for building

ex.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
ex.zh: 我新家的客廳很大。

ex.en: The living room furniture was modern in style.
ex.zh: 客廳的家具是現代風格。

ex.en: The living room is adjacent to the dining room.
ex.zh: 客廳緊鄰著餐廳。

living room.en: the main room in a house where people sit and relax

ex.en: The program aims to improve adult literacy in rural areas.
ex.zh: 這項計畫的目標是提升鄉村地區成人的識字率。

ex.en: Computer literacy is now an important skill.
ex.zh: 電腦素養現在是一項重要的技能。

literacy.en: the ability to read and write

linguist.zh: 語言學家、精通多國語言的人

ex.en: The linguist is fluent in several Chinese dialects.
ex.zh: 那個語言學家精通幾個中國方言。

ex.en: Generally speaking, women are better linguists than men.
ex.zh: 總體上說，女人是比男人好的語言學家。

ex.en: This man is a linguist. It's natural that he know.
ex.zh: 這男人是個語言學家，他自然知道。

linguist.en: a person who studies languages or speaks many of them

ex.en: He has a liking for modern music.
ex.zh: 他喜歡現代音樂。

ex.en: He suddenly took a liking to detective stories.
ex.zh: 他突然喜歡上了偵探小說。

ex.en: This is not to his liking.
ex.zh: 這是他不喜歡的。

liking.en: a feeling of enjoying or approving of something

ex.en: This village isn't big, but it's quite lively.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮不大,可是很熱鬧.

ex.en: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
ex.zh: 吃火鍋的時候 ,氣氛往往是非常熱鬧的.

ex.en: He's a bit lively.
ex.zh: 他有點活潑。

ex.en: She works as a liaison between the school and the parents.
ex.zh: 她擔任學校和家長之間的聯絡人。

ex.en: Good liaison between departments helps the company run smoothly.
ex.zh: 部門之間良好的聯繫讓公司運作順暢。

liaison.en: communication between groups, or a person who helps groups work together

linger.zh: 逗留、徘徊；（感覺等）揮之不去

ex.en: What are you lingering for? Hurry up and go.
ex.zh: 你磨蹭什麼呀，快點去吧。

ex.en: The shock of her father's death lingered on and she didn't feel like going out at all.
ex.zh: 父親過世的打擊一直揮之不去，她完全不想出門。

ex.en: The guests lingered over coffee long after dinner ended.
ex.zh: 晚餐結束後很久，客人們還在喝咖啡聊天，捨不得離開。

linger.en: to stay somewhere longer than needed, or to continue to be felt for a long time

ex.en: Fishing is the main livelihood of people in this village.
ex.zh: 捕魚是這個村莊居民主要的生計。

ex.en: The typhoon threatened the livelihood of many farmers.
ex.zh: 颱風威脅到許多農民的生計。

livelihood.en: the work or way a person earns money to live

ex.en: I majored in American literature at college.
ex.zh: 我在大學主修美國文學。

ex.en: He read English Literature at Oxford University.
ex.zh: 他在牛津大學念英國文學。

ex.en: He is already skilled in both math and literature.
ex.zh: 他數學和文學都很拿手。

literature.en: books, plays and poems that are considered works of art

ex.en: I found the apartment through an online listing.
ex.zh: 我是在網路上的物件資訊找到這間公寓的。

ex.en: Check the TV listings for tonight's programs.
ex.zh: 看一下今晚的電視節目表。

listing.en: an item in a list of things for sale or rent, or the list itself

ex.en: The bank faced a liquidity crisis.
ex.zh: 那家銀行面臨流動性危機。

ex.en: Cash gives a company more liquidity.
ex.zh: 現金讓公司擁有更高的流動性。

liquidity.en: how easily assets can be changed into cash

ex.en: The software licensing agreement limits how many devices each account can use.
ex.zh: 軟體授權協議限制每個帳號可使用的裝置數量。

ex.en: The brand earns licensing fees when another firm uses its characters.
ex.zh: 其他公司使用該品牌角色時，品牌方會收取授權費。

licensing.en: the giving of official permission to use or do something

ex.en: The hotel arranged a limousine to take the speakers to the venue.
ex.zh: 飯店安排豪華轎車接送講者前往會場。

ex.en: They arrived at the gala in a white limousine.
ex.zh: 他們搭乘白色禮車抵達晚宴。

limousine.en: a large, comfortable car, often driven by a paid driver

ex.en: Take the red line to the city center.
ex.zh: 搭紅線到市中心。

ex.en: This subway line runs every five minutes.
ex.zh: 這條捷運線每五分鐘一班。

line.en: a route that a train or bus follows

ex.en: These two lines cut across each other at right angles.
ex.zh: 這兩條線成直角相交。

ex.en: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
ex.zh: 地圖上的紅線代表鐵路。

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我朋友現在正在電話上。

ex.en: Please hold the line.
ex.zh: 請不要掛斷。

line.en: a connection that lets people talk by telephone

ex.zh: 麵包店外面大排長龍。

ex.en: Please wait in line.
ex.zh: 請排隊等候。

line.en: a row of people waiting one behind another

ex.zh: 我會和客戶聯絡協調交貨日期。

ex.zh: 她負責業務和設計團隊之間的聯絡協調。

liaise.en: to communicate with another person or group so that you can work well together

ex.zh: 你是做什麼工作維生的？

ex.zh: 這座城市的生活成本很高。

ex.en: The garden is full of living plants.
ex.zh: 花園裡長滿了活生生的植物。

ex.zh: 他是我們村裡現在最年長的人。

ex.en: You need a licence to drive a car.
ex.zh: 你需要有駕照才能開車。

ex.en: The restaurant has a licence to sell alcohol.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有販售酒類的許可證。

ex.en: The government licences only a few companies to run this service.
ex.zh: 政府只許可少數幾家公司經營這項服務。

ex.zh: 市政府核准街頭藝人在市區表演。

ex.zh: 狗的平均壽命大約是十二年。

ex.zh: 這顆電池的使用壽命是三年。

ex.zh: 她輕輕碰他的肩膀來引起他的注意。

ex.zh: 雪輕輕地落在安靜的街道上。

ex.zh: 魚只要用少許鹽和胡椒調味。

ex.zh: 雖然天氣很冷，他卻穿得很單薄。

ex.zh: 這是個重大的決定，所以不要掉以輕心。

ex.zh: 她從不輕率地談論別人的問題。

ex.zh: 獅子在動物園裡大聲吼叫。

ex.zh: 一群獅子在樹蔭下休息。

ex.zh: 這個國家慶祝城市的解放。

ex.zh: 許多人把教育視為通往解放的道路。

ex.zh: 這個房間的照明太暗，不適合看書。

ex.en: They changed the lighting to make the shop warmer.
ex.zh: 他們換了燈光，讓店裡更溫馨。

ex.zh: 請把蓋子蓋回罐子上。

ex.zh: 鍋蓋燙得不能碰。

ex.zh: 醫生查看了她左眼腫起來的眼瞼。

ex.zh: 我們先看到閃電，才聽到雷聲。

ex.zh: 她把一朵白百合插進花瓶裡。

ex.zh: 百合在春天聞起來很香。

ex.zh: 利物浦是英格蘭西北部的一座港口城市。

ex.zh: 許多遊客前往利物浦認識它的音樂歷史。

ex.zh: 莉斯是伊莉莎白的簡稱。

ex.zh: 麗莎每天上班前都跑五公里。

ex.zh: 我上週向麗莎借了這本書。

ex.zh: 琳達在當地國中教美術。

ex.zh: 琳達為她的朋友織了一條很漂亮的圍巾。

ex.zh: 在魚上擠一點萊姆汁。

ex.zh: 她在飲料裡加了一片萊姆。

ex.zh: 牆壁刷了石灰漿，好讓它保持白色。

ex.zh: 飯店每天都會更換床單被套等布品。

ex.zh: 夏天的炎熱中，她穿著細亞麻布做的襯衫。

ex.zh: 他為了婚禮買了一件白色亞麻外套。

ex.zh: 一塊亞麻桌巾蓋在長長的餐桌上。

ex.zh: 在這個國家，要年滿十八歲才能買酒。

ex.zh: 這家店賣啤酒、葡萄酒和烈酒。

ex.zh: 他們從幼稚園起就是一輩子的朋友。

ex.en: Learning a language can become a lifelong hobby.
ex.zh: 學語言可以成為一輩子的嗜好。

ex.zh: 我每天大約喝兩公升的水。

ex.en: The car uses one litre of fuel for every twelve kilometres.
ex.zh: 這輛車每行駛十二公里就耗掉一公升的油。

lincoln.zh: 林肯（美國第 16 任總統）

ex.en: Abraham Lincoln was the sixteenth president of the United States.
ex.zh: 亞伯拉罕·林肯是美國第十六任總統。

ex.en: Lincoln led the country during the Civil War.
ex.zh: 林肯在美國內戰期間領導這個國家。

ex.zh: 教練在比賽前公布了先發陣容。

ex.en: The festival has an amazing lineup of singers this year.
ex.zh: 這個音樂節今年的歌手陣容很驚人。

ex.zh: 小狗舔了我的手，還搖著尾巴。

ex.zh: 她在冰淇淋融化前舔了它。

ex.zh: 那隻貓快速舔了一下盤子。

ex.zh: 這間老房子需要稍微刷點漆。

ex.zh: 大雪讓餵養牲畜變得困難。

ex.zh: 牲畜每天都必須有乾淨的水喝。

ex.zh: 慶典之後，公園裡到處都是垃圾。

ex.zh: 請把你的垃圾丟進垃圾桶。

ex.zh: 在公共場所亂丟垃圾是很沒禮貌的。

ex.zh: 街上散落著紙杯。

ex.zh: 我們的貓生了一窩五隻小貓。

ex.zh: 農夫讓我們看了一窩小豬。

ex.zh: 那名中後衛在十碼線擒抱了跑鋒。

ex.zh: 他努力訓練，想成為大學美式足球的中後衛。

ex.zh: 離開前請檢查列出的項目。

listed.zh: 列出（list 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.zh: 她把所有需要買的東西都列了出來。

ex.zh: 他的名字列在第三頁。

ex.zh: 沒有人信任他，因為他是個愛說謊的人。

ex.en: She called him a liar after finding out the truth.
ex.zh: 她發現真相後罵他是個騙子。

ex.en: The newspaper was sued for libel after printing the false story.
ex.zh: 報社刊登不實報導後被控誹謗。

ex.zh: 捏造文字抹黑他人可能構成誹謗。

ex.zh: 這本雜誌被指控以文字誹謗那位知名歌手。

ex.zh: 他揚言要控告任何誹謗他公司的人。

ex.zh: 只有領有駕照的人才能在這裡租車。

ex.en: She is a licensed nurse with ten years of experience.
ex.zh: 她是有十年經驗的合格護理師。

lingering.zh: 揮之不去的；久久不散的

ex.zh: 一股久久不散的煙味瀰漫房間。

ex.zh: 她得完流感後咳嗽遲遲沒好。

ex.zh: 派對結束後，有些客人還在門口逗留。

ex.zh: 晚餐結束很久後，客人們還在喝著咖啡逗留不走。

ex.zh: 她在派對前塗上紅色口紅。

ex.zh: 咖啡杯上有一個口紅印。

ex.zh: 的黎波里是利比亞的首都。

ex.en: The people greeted the army as liberators.
ex.zh: 人民把那支軍隊當作解放者來歡迎。

ex.en: History books often call him the liberator of the town.
ex.zh: 歷史書常稱他為這座城鎮的解放者。

ex.en: The artist made a lifelike statue of her dog.
ex.zh: 藝術家替她的狗做了一座栩栩如生的雕像。

ex.en: The doll looked so lifelike that it scared me.
ex.zh: 這個娃娃看起來太逼真，把我嚇到了。

ex.en: My boss was livid when he saw the mistake.
ex.zh: 我老闆看到錯誤時氣炸了。

ex.en: She was livid about the late delivery.
ex.zh: 她對延遲送達非常火大。

ex.en: Tourism is the lifeblood of this small island.
ex.zh: 觀光是這座小島的命脈。

ex.en: Fresh ideas are the lifeblood of any creative team.
ex.zh: 新點子是任何創意團隊的命脈。

ex.en: The bank placed a lien on the house until the loan was paid.
ex.zh: 在貸款還清前，銀行對這棟房子設有留置權。

ex.en: You cannot sell the car while there is a lien on it.
ex.zh: 車子被設了留置權時，你不能賣掉它。

lifter.zh: 舉重者；舉起東西的人或裝置

ex.en: The weight lifter trained at the gym every day.
ex.zh: 那位舉重選手每天都在健身房訓練。

ex.en: A strong lifter can raise twice his own weight.
ex.zh: 強壯的舉重者能舉起自己體重兩倍的重量。

ex.en: She works as a litigator at a large law firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家大型律師事務所擔任訴訟律師。

ex.en: The company hired an experienced litigator to handle the lawsuit.
ex.zh: 公司聘請了一位經驗豐富的訴訟律師來處理這件官司。

ex.en: He had to duck under the low stone lintel.
ex.zh: 他得低頭穿過低矮的石製門楣。

ex.en: The builders placed a wooden lintel above the window.
ex.zh: 工人在窗戶上方安上一根木製過梁。

ex.en: She is the linchpin of our team, and everything depends on her.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊的關鍵人物，一切都仰賴她。

ex.en: Trust is the linchpin of any good friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何深厚友誼的關鍵。

ex.en: The hot weather left the dog feeling listless all afternoon.
ex.zh: 炎熱的天氣讓狗整個下午都無精打采。

ex.en: She felt listless after a week of poor sleep.
ex.zh: 一週沒睡好之後，她覺得提不起勁。

ex.en: The museum bought an old lithograph of the harbor.
ex.zh: 博物館買下一幅港口的老石版畫。

ex.en: He hung a framed lithograph above the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把一幅裱框的石版畫掛在沙發上方。

ex.en: She asked her doctor about the risks of liposuction.
ex.zh: 她向醫師詢問抽脂手術的風險。

ex.en: Liposuction is a surgery, not a simple way to lose weight.
ex.zh: 抽脂是一種手術，不是減重的簡單辦法。

ex.en: We put new lino on the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 我們在廚房地板鋪了新的油地氈。

ex.en: The old lino was cracked and faded.
ex.zh: 舊的油地氈已經裂開又褪色了。

ex.en: She loves the strong taste of licorice candy.
ex.zh: 她愛甘草糖的濃烈味道。

ex.en: Licorice root is sometimes used in herbal tea.
ex.zh: 甘草根有時會用在草本茶裡。

ex.en: Fireworks lit up the whole night sky.
ex.zh: 煙火照亮了整片夜空。

ex.en: A small lamp lights up the corner of the room.
ex.zh: 一盞小檯燈照亮了房間的角落。

ex.en: The street lights light up the road after dark.
ex.zh: 天黑後，路燈照亮了馬路。

light up.en: to fill a place with light

ex.en: Her face lit up when she saw the birthday cake.
ex.zh: 她看到生日蛋糕時，臉上亮了起來。

ex.en: The whole city lights up during the lantern festival.
ex.zh: 元宵節期間，整座城市都亮了起來。

ex.en: His eyes lit up at the sight of the gift.
ex.zh: 他一看到禮物，眼睛就亮了起來。

light up.en: to become bright, or to show joy on your face

ex.en: He stepped outside to light up a cigarette.
ex.zh: 他走到外面點了一根菸。

ex.en: Please don't light up in the car.
ex.zh: 請不要在車子裡點菸。

ex.en: Many people light up after a meal.
ex.zh: 很多人飯後會點一根菸。

ex.en: Students lined up outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 學生們在教室外排隊。

ex.en: Customers were lining up to buy the new phone.
ex.zh: 顧客們排著隊要買新手機。

ex.en: Please line up here for the ticket check.
ex.zh: 請在這裡排隊接受查票。

line up.en: to stand in a line and wait

ex.en: She lined up the cups neatly on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把杯子整齊地排在架子上。

ex.en: Line up the two edges before you glue them.
ex.zh: 黏之前先把兩個邊緣對齊。

ex.en: The kids lined up their toys along the wall.
ex.zh: 孩子們把玩具沿著牆排成一列。

line up.en: to put things in a straight row

ex.en: I've lined up three interviews for next week.
ex.zh: 我已經安排好下週的三場面試。

ex.en: They lined up a guest speaker for the event.
ex.zh: 他們為活動安排了一位客座講者。

ex.en: Have you lined up a place to stay yet?
ex.zh: 你已經找好住的地方了嗎？

line up.en: to arrange for something to happen

ex.en: The old man lives on alone in a small village.
ex.zh: 那位老先生獨自繼續住在一個小村莊。

ex.en: Her kind words will live on in our hearts.
ex.zh: 她溫暖的話語會長存我們心中。

ex.en: The singer's music lives on after all these years.
ex.zh: 這位歌手的音樂過了這麼多年仍然流傳著。

live on.en: to continue to live or exist

ex.en: Pandas live on bamboo.
ex.zh: 貓熊以竹子為主食。

ex.en: They live on a very small income.
ex.zh: 他們靠很微薄的收入過活。

ex.en: As a student, I lived on noodles for a month.
ex.zh: 當學生時，我有一個月都靠麵條過日子。

live on.en: to eat a certain food or use a certain amount of money

ex.en: The new phone didn't live up to my expectations.
ex.zh: 這支新手機沒有達到我的期望。

ex.en: She worked hard to live up to her parents' hopes.
ex.zh: 她努力不辜負父母的期望。

ex.en: The movie lived up to all the praise it got.
ex.zh: 這部電影不負眾人的稱讚。

live up to.en: to be as good as people expected

ex.en: I need to lie down for a few minutes.
ex.zh: 我需要躺下休息幾分鐘。

ex.en: The doctor told him to lie down on the bed.
ex.zh: 醫生叫他躺到床上。

lie down.en: to put your body flat on a bed or the ground

ex.en: I like to listen to music on the bus.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在公車上聽音樂。

ex.en: Please listen to your teacher carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細聽老師說話。

listen to.en: to pay attention to a sound or a person speaking

ex.en: Listen up, everyone, the rules have changed.
ex.zh: 大家聽好了，規則改了。

ex.en: The coach said, "Listen up, this is important."
ex.zh: 教練說：「聽好，這很重要。」

listen up.en: to pay close attention to what someone is about to say

ex.en: She lives with her grandparents in Tainan.
ex.zh: 她和祖父母一起住在台南。

ex.en: I lived with three roommates in college.
ex.zh: 我大學時和三個室友住在一起。

live with.en: to share a home with someone

ex.en: You have to live with the noise in this city.
ex.zh: 你得適應這座城市的噪音。

ex.en: He had to live with his mistake for years.
ex.zh: 他多年來都得面對自己犯的錯。

live with.en: to accept something unpleasant and learn to deal with it

ex.en: Little by little, her English got better.
ex.zh: 她的英文漸漸進步了。

ex.en: We saved money little by little to buy a car.
ex.zh: 我們一點一點存錢，準備買車。
